messages:
maggie.marketing: Hey team — new launch post draft (v1.0) is live: https://docs.google.com/example/launch-v1.0. Need quick editorial + legal pass, and final UTMs for the demo funnel by EOD so we can queue publish + webinar invites.

rachel.copy: reading now. Suggest compressing hero to a single strong line and moving the customer quote up to open with impact. I'll push edits in the next 90m.

devon.growth: CTA buckets we need: hosted signup, dedicated trial request, enterprise pilot request. Proposed utm_content values: hosted_get_started, dedicated_trial_req, enterprise_pilot_request.

nate.ops: UTMs look good. CRM snippet I'll use:
```
utm_campaign=redwood_launch_may2026
utm_source=blog
utm_medium=cta
utm_content=hosted_get_started|dedicated_trial_req|enterprise_pilot_request
```
I'll create routing rules once strings are final. Also will add a pixel on /pricing to flag enterprise interest.

elaine.legal: Quick legal guidance: remove any absolute comparative language (no "best"/"lowest"). Add a short Data Controls line: "Supports SOC2 and optional customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM); configurable retention policies." Approving after those edits.

rachel.copy: removed superlatives and added the KMS/HSM + retention line. Linked the benchmark appendix instead of embedding the full chart; included one-line takeaway with a TODO percent placeholder.

gina.events: webinar proposal: Thu May 13, 2026 at 16:00 UTC. Recommend reserving 14 demo slots post-webinar and a waitlist form. I'll draft a 2-line calendar blurb and demo signup form after publish.

devon.growth: Sales request: anyone who clicks enterprise_pilot_request and then visits /pricing should be auto-tagged as PQL and assigned to AE queue. Nate, can you add that workflow?

nate.ops: Yep — will add a pixel on /pricing and workflow: visit_pricing && utm_content=enterprise_pilot_request => tag: blog_launch_enterprise + assign to AE.

publish-bot: Reminder: content embargo candidate set for 2026-05-10 09:00 UTC. React with :white_check_mark: when you approve final copy.

maggie.marketing: Timeline: Rachel finalizes copy by 18:00 UTC, Elaine legal signoff by 19:00, Devon confirms UTMs/tracking by 19:15, Gina locks invites. If all green we'll lift embargo tomorrow AM. I'll paste final doc link here when done. :white_check_mark:
